svg.title: Credential management and PostgreSQL schemas
svg.desc: Implemented MVP: per-project PostgreSQL database and login; mounted source credentials and encryption key; encrypted shared OAuth state and SQL refresh leases.
svg.text: On token use: SQL recheck after 1 s
On token use: SQL recheck after 1 s
Restart: decrypt and reuse valid shared state.
Source credentials and Kₐ stay in mounted files.
Own local caches and connection pools
Project replicas share auth state. Projects have separate databases, logins and encryption keys.
ciphertext = nonce + AES-256-GCM({value, expires}); AAD = id/version
2 Conditional UPDATE: claim 12 s lease; increment version
3 Authenticate over HTTPS · 8 s timeout · no SQL transaction / connection held
Derived token + lifetime; refresh margin = min(TTL / 10, 30 s)
4 Encrypt + publish WHERE owner/version match AND lease is valid
Acquisition failure: release lease; retry_after = now() + 2 s.
Crash: lease expires. Superseded or expired owners cannot publish.
Leases fence SQL publication; external login is not exactly once after a crash.
On token use: memory if checked < 1 s ago; otherwise read SQL.
Explicit invalidation: version++; clear token and lease. Peers re-read on use.
Source credential change: new record ID. No notification / pub-sub channel.
